About the Pink Hummer Limo

A wet bar and a champagne bar, both lit. Star lighting overhead, ambient lighting through the cabin, lit speakers, and ambient lighting outside. A custom sound system with custom subs, and a partition from the chauffeur.

Perfection on wheels for every celebration of women: the bachelorette first, the girls’ birthday, prom, Cinco de Mayo, the night out. It is our most popular ride for women, and it is beautiful.

Seats: Handmade custom leather seats, plush and comfortable

Pink Hummer Limo rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $295 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way event transfer from $650. Seats 18.

Pink Hummer limo rental: the short answers

How many people fit? Up to 18 guests, on handmade custom leather seats. It is a stretch limousine rather than a bus: a low cabin you sit in, not an aisle you stand in.

What does it cost? $295/hr with a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $1,180 before 8% Arizona sales tax; 7 or more hours earns 1 free hour, 12 or more hours earns 2 free hours, 15 or more hours earns 3 free hours. A one-way transfer is $650, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included.

Can we drink on board? Guests 21 and over may bring their own drinks; Scottsdale Sprinters sells no alcohol. If anyone on the trip is under 21, prom included, the trip is alcohol-free. The ride rules and the Arizona party bus alcohol guide have the details.

Are there other pink limos for rent? Not with us: the Pink Hummer Limo is the only pink unit in the fleet. For more than 18 guests, the Party Bus (28 Pax) seats 28. The pink party bus guide compares the two.

Where does it pick up? Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley. Send the date, the pickup address, the stops and the guest count, and the checkout prices the night.
